guides.title: Application guides
guides.intro: This site helps you research study programmes and paid research or doctoral opportunities. Applications must be submitted by you through the official university or employer channel.
guides.body: Choose the language of instruction first, then check admission language evidence, extra language needs for placements or clinics, tuition terms, and the current application round. A CSCSE lookup is a reference, not a personal recognition guarantee. Research jobs use working language and doctoral enrollment filters, not teaching-language filters.

footer.disclaimer: This site does not invent admission odds or user reviews. Unknown tuition is not free. Closed vacancies are removed from public lists.

institutions.intro: Names, ownership and university / non-university type come from the Ministry register. CSCSE “listed” rows come from an operator-supplied list dated 2026-09-06, matched to current register names; this is not a live scrape of the CSCSE portal. This is not a verified admissions catalogue; programmes and deadlines are not invented.

map.title: Institution map
map.intro: The map is an auxiliary view; the list is the data. The interactive view loads standard OpenStreetMap tiles when online. If tiles fail, it automatically switches to the bundled 14-region Czech overview while the core list and filters remain available.
map.disclaimer: Identity stays on the ministry register. Coordinates prefer Wikidata P625 when IČO, website host, or the official Czech name matches uniquely; otherwise the register seat is geocoded with Nominatim. Missing points are not invented. At low zoom the interactive view groups nearby schools into keyboard-operable count buttons; zooming in restores a separate button for each school, with exactly coincident pins slightly spread around their source coordinate. Use the list to verify the school. The CSCSE name “College of Political and Social Sciences” is not on the current register, so it is not plotted.
